verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official MCP server that an LLM or AI-assisted IDE can integrate with, covering Wallets, Contracts, CCTP and Gateway (circle-docs-9). A probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists (circle-probe-3). Its stated scope is helping agents generate and fix code rather than executing wallet or payment operations directly. missing for 10: evidence of action-oriented MCP tools (e.g., creating wallets or sending transfers via MCP), setup/connection and auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
